title: Remote Sensing
description: A telescope turned round: from orbit, in visible light and infrared and radar, the whole ground at once. Unlocks the Survey Satellite.

puzzle.goal: A satellite at height h looks down through a telescope of aperture D at light of wavelength λ. Write the smallest separation x it can tell apart on the surface.
puzzle.name: Diffraction-limited footprint
puzzle.ask: Find x in metres for L = @{L} m, h = 7e5 m, D = @{D} m.
puzzle.method: The smallest angle a circular aperture resolves is 1.22λ/D; at distance h that angle spans x.
